changes: New: a record of work done on the house. Household now keeps a dated log of what the plumber, the electrician or the boiler service actually did — what it cost, how long it's guaranteed for, and who to ring if it goes again. Your car has had this for ages; the house didn't.

Tell the assistant and it files it: “the plumber came Tuesday and replaced the boiler valve, 180 euro, two-year guarantee”. If that plumber is already in your vendor list the two are linked automatically, and a tradesman's invoice can be scanned straight in.
The entry keeps the name of whoever did the work, so your history still reads properly years later even if you've since removed them from your vendor list.
The guided-setup cards are easier to read at a glance — the label at the top of each one is bigger, and picks up the same colour sweep as the progress bar above it.
